note: Alias fallback for models that ignore IPA phonemes; keep in sync with pronunciation_es.pls. Numbers and prices: the pipeline expands placeholders to words BEFORE TTS (es-US: '$12' -> 'doce dólares', '$25/mes' -> 'veinticinco dólares al mes', '17 in' -> 'diecisiete pulgadas', '20 lb' -> 'veinte libras', '5,000' -> 'cinco mil'); never let the model read '$' or '/' symbols.
